art_style.rendering: Digital vector-like 2D art, cel-shaded with soft ambient occlusion, crisp finish

character_proportions.head: Enlarged, rounded facial structure with soft cheeks
character_proportions.limbs: Shortened, stout limbs; stylized hands with simplified fingers and rounded shoes/feet

eyes.details: Crisp dark outline, glossy highlights, detailed iris gradients

facial_features.expression: Warm, cheerful, friendly smirk or gentle smile
facial_features.aging_and_details: Minimalist facial lines; age is captured via hair color/shape, glasses, and subtle folds rather than deep wrinkles

line_art.outer_contour: Bold, clean, consistent black outline framing the entire silhouette
line_art.inner_lines: Medium-to-fine clean black/dark line work defining inner garments and facial details
line_art.sketchiness: None (zero pencil textures, zero scratchy strokes)

color_palette_and_shading.colors: Rich, saturated yet earthy palette; distinct solid block colors per garment/element
color_palette_and_shading.shading_type: Two-tone cel shading (base tone + solid shadow plane) combined with subtle smooth gradient highlights
color_palette_and_shading.lighting: Clean, directional light slightly from the top-front

composition_and_framing.viewpoint: Straight-on eye level, strictly front-facing orthographic perspective
composition_and_framing.pose: Full body standing centered, ground-planted, symmetrical or lightly posed
composition_and_framing.background: Pure white background (#FFFFFF), entirely clean and isolated
composition_and_framing.shadow: No cast shadow, no ground shadow beneath the character

instructions_for_generation: When applied to a reference image, extract the subject's key facial features, hairstyle, attire, and accessories, then reimagine them adhering strictly to the 'style_definition' parameters above.
